mapper.select: SELECT record_id, payload, delivered, attempts, last_error FROM dietary_outbox WHERE record_id = #{id}
SELECT record_id, payload, delivered, attempts, last_error FROM dietary_outbox WHERE delivered = FALSE AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY updated_at, record_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE dietary_outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE record_id = #{id}
UPDATE dietary_outbox SET delivered = TRUE, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE record_id = #{id}
UPDATE dietary_outbox SET last_error = #{error}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE record_id = #{id}
